biotools.summary: ImmiR is a database that integrates curated data from scientific literature and bioinformatics analyses to define immune checkpoint pathways and their associations with microRNAs and tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes. It provides a user-friendly web interface with functional visualizations for exploring these relationships.
